title: Roster
description: diarization-skill/roster@1. The caller's list of people expected in a recording (the programme), input to `diarization name`. Voiceprint paths are relative to the roster file. src/diarization_skill/naming.py (load_roster) is the executable form.

name.description: as it should appear once a person confirms it

role.description: free text, for example chair or speaker

aliases.description: other spellings matched in lower thirds (another script, name order)

voiceprint.description: a diarization-skill/voiceprint@1 file of this person (diarization enroll)
